notes.title: Guild of Rogues releases in Early Access today!
notes.notes:
[h2]The wait is finally over: Guild of Rogues hits Early Access today! [/h2]

We are so happy to announce that Guild of Rogues is launching today! This initial version already has content for dozens of hours of gameplay; here are some highlights:

[list]
[*] 140+ Minions
[*] 70+ Relics
[*] 6 Classes
[*] 5 Difficulty Levels
[/list]

[h2]Roadmap[/h2]

[b]Guild of Rogues is planned to be in Early Access for 8 to 12 months. [/b]

While in EA, it will receive regular updates that will add new content, as well as fixing bugs and making balance changes! But, the big changes will come in 3 Major Updates, detailed below.

Of course, during the course of development, priorities and timelines may change. 

[h3]🗺️ Major Update 1[/h3]

New systems:
[list]
[*] Map/area selection
[*] Resources
[/list]

New content:
[list]
[*] 2 Factions (70+ Minions and 35+ Relics)
[*] 7+ Classes
[*] 5 new difficulty Tiers
[/list]

When?
[list]
[*] Summer
[/list]

[h3]⚔️ Major Update 2[/h3]

New systems:
[list]
[*] New game mode: Survival (Endless)
[*] Boss overhaul
[/list]

New content:
[list]
[*] 1 Factions (35+ Minions and 20+ Relics)
[*] 5+ Classes
[/list]

When?
[list]
[*] Fall
[/list]

[h3]🚀  Major Update 3: full release![/h3]

New systems:
[list]
[*] Customization
[*] Increased level cap
[*] Survival Mode Meta-Progression
[*] And more!
[/list]

New content:
[list]
[*] 2 Factions (70+ Minions and 35+ Relics)
[*] 15+ Classes
[/list]

When?
[list]
[*] Early 2025
[/list]

notes.title: Guild of Rogues Demo - Update: 0.0.2
notes.notes:
[h1]Guild of Rogues' first patch is here![/h1]

Hey!

It's been a little over a week since our demo launch, and I'm having a blast seeing your gameplay and hearing your feedback on the demo.

While we keep working on the Early Access version, the demo will be updated to fix major bugs, but for this small patch I also made some small balance changes that should make the limited experience with the demo a bit better!

Thank you so much for anyone that has given it a try!

[b][h2]Balance changes:[/h2][/b]

[Class] Mercenary: Gives 1 gold instead of 2 at the end of each combat
[Relic] Honor Medal: Now is Rare instead of Epic
[Minion] Kraken: Now is Legendary instead of Epic

[b][h2]Bug fixes:[/h2][/b]

Fixed a bug that made it impossible to choose a new Relic after restarting a run

notes.title: Special Live Stream: Guild of Rogues Demo Launch!
notes.notes:
Join us for the launch of the Guild of Rogues' Demo!!!

----------

About the game:

Guild of Rogues mixes the strategy of roguelike deckbuilding with the fun and casual nature of autobattlers, creating a rich and deep experience! It's a game for everyone, with mechanics that start off simple and approachable, that get more complex as you unlock new classes, minions and relics with crazy effects and synergies!

Defeat all enemies!

At the start of each battle, both enemies and minions will be placed on the board to fight automatically. Your minions will make their basic Attacks and activate their Skills to try and defeat all enemies before their turn counter reaches 0!

Build your team!

With hundreds of different minions and relics, after each turn you will have to strategically choose which option is the best one, considering synergies and what your team is lacking. As you progress in the game, you will unlock even more options to create the best mercenary team possible!

Create synergies!

In order to win, you will have to create a very strong team that works well together. For example, the pirates are great at gaining more gold, and the legendary Black Beard will fire all Cannons, repeating for every 10 gold you have! Or, maybe, just let the Kraken eat all of your pirates, and grab some Undead minions that trigger their effects when a minion is removed.
